alan: Hey team — I accepted the GitHub invite but when I try to push over HTTPS I get HTTP 403: \"You must enable SSO to access this org\" even though I clicked the SSO connect button in the invite flow. Anyone seen this?

mira: Hi Alan, welcome! Two quick checks: did you accept SSO after signing in with your work account, and are you auth'd in your local git/credential helper with the same account?

alan: I accepted via Okta and signed in on github.com. Locally I'm using the macOS credential helper with my personal account still cached. Could that cause the 403?

jen: Yep — that will. If your credential helper supplies a personal token/creds GitHub will reject push to an org requiring SSO. Try clearing the cached creds or configure gh auth login with your work account.

onboard-bot: Onboarding state: alan (alan@redwood.ai) — SSO clicked, SSH not added, flagged for credentials fix doc.

alan: I switched to SSH but now pushing errors with: \"error: src refspec feature/docs not found\" — haha, user error. Recreated branch, still blocked by \"protected branch\" when pushing directly to main.

mira: We don't allow direct pushes to main. Create a branch and open a PR. If your team membership isn't mapped you might not have PR write permissions either. Which repo?

alan: repo is redwood/docs-site. I need to push a docs patch to trigger the preview site. Can someone add me to docs-editors team?

jen: I can add you. Before I do, what GitHub username are you using (just to avoid alias mismatch)?

alan: username is alan-dev. Email on invite is alan@redwood.ai but I also have alan.personal@gmail linked to my account.

jen: Thanks. I added alan-dev to docs-editors and re-ran the team sync for the org. You should now have push/PR permissions to a new branch. Try:
```bash
git checkout -b docs/preview-fix
# make change
git add static/help.html
git commit -m \"docs: fix link\"
git push --set-upstream origin docs/preview-fix
```

alan: Push worked, PR created, preview built. Two small follow-ups: (1) docs to remind new-hires to clear credential helper if they used personal GH before; (2) onboarding step to detect email alias mismatches and warn.

onboard-bot: Logged suggestions to onboarding ticket #ONB-77.

mira: Great suggestions — filing an ops doc update. Welcome aboard, Alan! :wave:
